const patch = [
"diff --git a/cpp/tests/replay_offline_videos.py b/cpp/tests/replay_offline_videos.py",
"new file mode 100644",
"--- /dev/null",
"+++ b/cpp/tests/replay_offline_videos.py",
"@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@",
"+from __future__ import annotations",
"+",
"+import argparse",
"+import json",
"+import statistics",
"+import time",
"+import urllib.request",
"+from collections import Counter",
"+from pathlib import Path",
"+",
"+import cv2",
"+",
"+",
"+def request_json(url: str, body: bytes = b\"\", headers: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> dict:",
"+    request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers or {}, method=\"POST\")",
"+    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:",
"+        return json.loads(response.read().decode(\"utf-8\"))",
"+",
"+",
"+def percentile(values: list[float], fraction: float) -> float:",
"+    if not values:",
"+        return 0.0",
"+    ordered = sorted(values)",
"+    index = min(len(ordered) - 1, max(0, int(round((len(ordered) - 1) * fraction))))",
"+    return ordered[index]",
"+",
"+",
"+def replay(video: Path, endpoint: str, frame_limit: int) -> dict[str, object]:",
"+    request_json(f\"{endpoint}/v1/stream/reset\")",
"+    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(video))",
"+    states: Counter[str] = Counter()",
"+    sources: Counter[str] = Counter()",
"+    latencies: list[float] = []",
"+    contact_frames = 0",
"+    max_contact_age = 0",
"+    max_detector_age = 0",
"+    failures: list[str] = []",
"+    frame_id = 0",
"+    started = time.monotonic()",
"+    try:",
"+        while frame_id < frame_limit:",
"+            ok, frame = capture.read()",
"+            if not ok:",
"+                break",
"+            encoded_ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(\".jpg\", frame, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 85])",
"+            if not encoded_ok:",
"+                failures.append(\"jpeg_encode_failed\")",
"+                break",
"+            timestamp_ms = frame_id * 33",
"+            payload = request_json(",
"+                f\"{endpoint}/v1/stream/frame\",",
"+                encoded.tobytes(),",
"+                {",
"+                    \"Content-Type\": \"image/jpeg\",",
"+                    \"X-Frame-Id\": str(frame_id),",
"+                    \"X-Capture-Timestamp-Ms\": str(timestamp_ms),",
"+                },",
"+            )",
"+            result = payload[\"result\"]",
"+            states[str(result[\"state\"])] += 1",
"+            sources[str(result[\"bbox_source\"])] += 1",
"+            latencies.append(float(result[\"timings_ms\"][\"total\"]))",
"+            contact_frames += int(result[\"contact_point\"] is not None)",
"+            max_contact_age = max(max_contact_age, int(result[\"contact_age_ms\"]))",
"+            max_detector_age = max(max_detector_age, int(result[\"detector_age_ms\"]))",
"+            if result[\"contact_point\"] is not None and int(result[\"contact_age_ms\"]) > 150:",
"+                failures.append(f\"stale_contact:{frame_id}\")",
"+            if result[\"device_bbox\"] is not None and int(result[\"detector_age_ms\"]) > 250:",
"+                failures.append(f\"stale_device:{frame_id}\")",
"+            if result[\"state\"] in {\"UNCERTAIN\", \"LOST\", \"SEARCHING\"} and result[\"contact_point\"] is not None:",
"+                failures.append(f\"contact_in_invalid_state:{frame_id}\")",
"+            frame_id += 1",
"+    finally:",
"+        capture.release()",
"+    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started",
"+    return {",
"+        \"video\": str(video),",
"+        \"frames\": frame_id,",
"+        \"states\": dict(states),",
"+        \"bbox_sources\": dict(sources),",
"+        \"contact_frames\": contact_frames,",
"+        \"max_contact_age_ms\": max_contact_age,",
"+        \"max_detector_age_ms\": max_detector_age,",
"+        \"mean_runtime_ms\": statistics.mean(latencies) if latencies else 0.0,",
"+        \"p95_runtime_ms\": percentile(latencies, 0.95),",
"+        \"wall_fps\": frame_id / elapsed if elapsed > 0 else 0.0,",
"+        \"failures\": failures,",
"+        \"result\": \"PASS\" if frame_id > 0 and not failures else \"BLOCKED\",",
"+    }",
"+",
"+",
"+def main() -> int:",
"+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()",
"+    parser.add_argument(\"--endpoint\", required=True)",
"+    parser.add_argument(\"--video-root\", type=Path, required=True)",
"+    parser.add_argument(\"--output\", type=Path, required=True)",
"+    parser.add_argument(\"--frames-per-video\", type=int, default=60)",
"+    args = parser.parse_args()",
"+    videos = sorted(args.video_root.rglob(\"*.webm\"))",
"+    if len(videos) != 10:",
"+        raise RuntimeError(f\"expected 10 WebM files, found {len(videos)}\")",
"+    rows = [replay(video, args.endpoint, args.frames_per_video) for video in videos]",
"+    report = {",
"+        \"schema_version\": 1,",
"+        \"videos\": rows,",
"+        \"videos_checked\": len(rows),",
"+        \"frames_checked\": sum(int(row[\"frames\"]) for row in rows),",
"+        \"result\": \"PASS\" if all(row[\"result\"] == \"PASS\" for row in rows) else \"BLOCKED\",",
"+    }",
"+    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)",
"+    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")",
"+    print(f\"CPP_OFFLINE_VIDEO_REPLAY={report['result']}\")",
"+    print(f\"VIDEOS={report['videos_checked']} FRAMES={report['frames_checked']}\")",
"+    return 0 if report[\"result\"] == \"PASS\" else 1",
"+",
"+",
"+if __name__ == \"__main__\":",
"+    raise SystemExit(main())",
+""
].join("\n");

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import statistics
import time
import urllib.request
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import cv2


def request_json(url: str, body: bytes = b"", headers: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> dict:
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers or {}, method="POST")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
        return json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))


def percentile(values: list[float], fraction: float) -> float:
    if not values:
        return 0.0
    ordered = sorted(values)
    index = min(len(ordered) - 1, max(0, int(round((len(ordered) - 1) * fraction))))
    return ordered[index]


def replay(video: Path, endpoint: str, frame_limit: int) -> dict[str, object]:
    request_json(f"{endpoint}/v1/stream/reset")
    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(video))
    states: Counter[str] = Counter()
    sources: Counter[str] = Counter()
    latencies: list[float] = []
    contact_frames = 0
    max_contact_age = 0
    max_detector_age = 0
    failures: list[str] = []
    frame_id = 0
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        while frame_id < frame_limit:
            ok, frame = capture.read()
            if not ok:
                break
            encoded_ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", frame, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 85])
            if not encoded_ok:
                failures.append("jpeg_encode_failed")
                break
            timestamp_ms = frame_id * 33
            payload = request_json(
                f"{endpoint}/v1/stream/frame",
                encoded.tobytes(),
                {
                    "Content-Type": "image/jpeg",
                    "X-Frame-Id": str(frame_id),
                    "X-Capture-Timestamp-Ms": str(timestamp_ms),
                },
            )
            result = payload["result"]
            states[str(result["state"])] += 1
            sources[str(result["bbox_source"])] += 1
            latencies.append(float(result["timings_ms"]["total"]))
            contact_frames += int(result["contact_point"] is not None)
            max_contact_age = max(max_contact_age, int(result["contact_age_ms"]))
            max_detector_age = max(max_detector_age, int(result["detector_age_ms"]))
            if result["contact_point"] is not None and int(result["contact_age_ms"]) > 150:
                failures.append(f"stale_contact:{frame_id}")
            if result["device_bbox"] is not None and int(result["detector_age_ms"]) > 250:
                failures.append(f"stale_device:{frame_id}")
            if result["state"] in {"UNCERTAIN", "LOST", "SEARCHING"} and result["contact_point"] is not None:
                failures.append(f"contact_in_invalid_state:{frame_id}")
            frame_id += 1
    finally:
        capture.release()
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
    return {
        "video": str(video),
        "frames": frame_id,
        "states": dict(states),
        "bbox_sources": dict(sources),
        "contact_frames": contact_frames,
        "max_contact_age_ms": max_contact_age,
        "max_detector_age_ms": max_detector_age,
        "mean_runtime_ms": statistics.mean(latencies) if latencies else 0.0,
        "p95_runtime_ms": percentile(latencies, 0.95),
        "wall_fps": frame_id / elapsed if elapsed > 0 else 0.0,
        "failures": failures,
        "result": "PASS" if frame_id > 0 and not failures else "BLOCKED",
    }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--endpoint", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--video-root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--frames-per-video", type=int, default=60)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    videos = sorted(args.video_root.rglob("*.webm"))
    if len(videos) != 10:
        raise RuntimeError(f"expected 10 WebM files, found {len(videos)}")
    rows = [replay(video, args.endpoint, args.frames_per_video) for video in videos]
    report = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "videos": rows,
        "videos_checked": len(rows),
        "frames_checked": sum(int(row["frames"]) for row in rows),
        "result": "PASS" if all(row["result"] == "PASS" for row in rows) else "BLOCKED",
    }
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"CPP_OFFLINE_VIDEO_REPLAY={report['result']}")
    print(f"VIDEOS={report['videos_checked']} FRAMES={report['frames_checked']}")
    return 0 if report["result"] == "PASS" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

set -euo pipefail

project_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
asset_root="${MEDVISION_ASSET_ROOT:-/home/lzttttt/mubiao--test}"

device_predictions="$asset_root/output-camera-active-v5/device/real_only/test/predictions.jsonl"
contact_predictions="$asset_root/models/camera_active_v5/contact/test_predictions.jsonl"
video_root="$asset_root/data/camera_active_v1/sessions"

mkdir -p "$gold_root"
sed -n '1,100p' "$device_predictions" > "$gold_root/python_device_predictions_100.jsonl"
sed -n '1,100p' "$contact_predictions" > "$gold_root/python_contact_predictions_100.jsonl"

if [[ "$(wc -l < "$gold_root/python_device_predictions_100.jsonl")" -ne 100 ]]; then
  echo "Expected exactly 100 device reference predictions" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ "$(wc -l < "$gold_root/python_contact_predictions_100.jsonl")" -ne 100 ]]; then
  echo "Expected exactly 100 contact reference predictions" >&2
  exit 1
fi

sed -E 's/.*"image_path": "([^"]+)".*/\1/' "$gold_root/python_contact_predictions_100.jsonl" |
  while IFS= read -r image_path; do
    sha256sum "$image_path"
  done > "$gold_root/image_sha256_100.txt"

find "$video_root" -type f -iname '*.webm' -print0 | sort -z |
  xargs -0 sha256sum > "$gold_root/video_sha256_10.txt"
if [[ "$(wc -l < "$gold_root/video_sha256_10.txt")" -ne 10 ]]; then
  echo "Expected exactly 10 video references" >&2
  exit 1
fi

cat > "$gold_root/README.md" <<'EOF'
# CPP offline runtime gold references

This directory freezes 100 V5 still-image Python outputs and all 10 existing
camera WebM inputs for C++ parity and video regression. The hashes refer to
the original immutable assets; images and videos are not copied here.

Coordinate parity tolerance is at most 1 original-image pixel. The product
runtime uses unmirrored coordinates; browser selfie mirroring is display-only.
EOF

(
  cd "$gold_root"
  sha256sum README.md image_sha256_100.txt python_contact_predictions_100.jsonl \
    python_device_predictions_100.jsonl video_sha256_10.txt > MANIFEST_SHA256
)
echo "CPP_OFFLINE_GOLD=$gold_root"

+  -> LK 光流 + Kalman 连续跟踪
+  -> 每 5 个快速帧执行 YOLOX 校正和自动重发现
+  -> V5 MobileNetV3-Small 接触点
+  -> MediaPipe 478 点 Face Landmarker
+  -> 中文解剖区域映射
+\`\`\`

+- \`POST /v1/infer/image\`
+- \`POST /v1/stream/start\`
+- \`POST /v1/stream/reset\`
+- \`POST /v1/stream/frame\`
+

function toBase64Utf8(s) {
  const encoded = encodeURIComponent(s);
  const bytes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < encoded.length; i++) {
    if (encoded[i] === "%") {
      bytes.push(parseInt(encoded.slice(i + 1, i + 3), 16));
      i += 2;
    } else {
      bytes.push(encoded.charCodeAt(i));
    }
  }
  const chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
  let out = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
    const a = bytes[i];
    const b = i + 1 < bytes.length ? bytes[i + 1] : 0;
    const c = i + 2 < bytes.length ? bytes[i + 2] : 0;
    out += chars[a >> 2];
    out += chars[((a & 3) << 4) | (b >> 4)];
    out += i + 1 < bytes.length ? chars[((b & 15) << 2) | (c >> 6)] : "=";
    out += i + 2 < bytes.length ? chars[c & 63] : "=";
  }
  return out;
}

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path


def load_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line]


def post_image(endpoint: str, image_path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        endpoint,
        data=image_path.read_bytes(),
        headers={"Content-Type": "image/jpeg"},
        method="POST",
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
        payload = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
    if not payload.get("ok"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"inference failed for {image_path}: {payload}")
    return payload["result"]


def maximum_coordinate_error(expected: list[float], actual: list[float]) -> float:
    return max(abs(float(left) - float(right)) for left, right in zip(expected, actual))


def point_error(expected: list[float], actual: list[float]) -> float:
    return math.hypot(float(expected[0]) - float(actual[0]), float(expected[1]) - float(actual[1]))


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--endpoint", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--gold", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=100)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    rows = load_jsonl(args.gold)[: args.limit]
    bbox_errors: list[float] = []
    contact_errors: list[float] = []
    failures: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        image_path = Path(str(row["image_path"]))
        result = post_image(args.endpoint, image_path)
        expected_bbox = row.get("detected_bbox")
        actual_bbox = result.get("device_bbox")
        expected_point = row.get("predicted_point")
        actual_point = result.get("contact_point")

        reasons: list[str] = []
        bbox_error = None
        contact_error = None
        if expected_bbox is None:
            if actual_bbox is not None:
                reasons.append("unexpected_device_bbox")
        elif actual_bbox is None:
            reasons.append("missing_device_bbox")
        else:
            bbox_error = maximum_coordinate_error(expected_bbox, actual_bbox)
            bbox_errors.append(bbox_error)
            if bbox_error > 1.0:
                reasons.append("device_bbox_error_gt_1px")

        if expected_point is None:
            if actual_point is not None:
                reasons.append("unexpected_contact_point")
        elif actual_point is None:
            reasons.append("missing_contact_point")
        else:
            contact_error = point_error(expected_point, actual_point)
            contact_errors.append(contact_error)
            if contact_error > 1.0:
                reasons.append("contact_point_error_gt_1px")

        if reasons:
            failures.append({
                "index": index,
                "image_path": str(image_path),
                "reasons": reasons,
                "bbox_error_px": bbox_error,
                "contact_error_px": contact_error,
                "actual_review_reasons": result.get("review_reasons", []),
            })

    report = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "images_checked": len(rows),
        "bbox_pairs_checked": len(bbox_errors),
        "contact_pairs_checked": len(contact_errors),
        "bbox_max_abs_error_px": max(bbox_errors, default=0.0),
        "contact_max_error_px": max(contact_errors, default=0.0),
        "failure_count": len(failures),
        "failures": failures,
        "result": "PASS" if not failures else "BLOCKED",
    }
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"CPP_OFFLINE_IMAGE_PARITY={report['result']}")
    print(f"BBOX_MAX_ERROR_PX={report['bbox_max_abs_error_px']:.6f}")
    print(f"CONTACT_MAX_ERROR_PX={report['contact_max_error_px']:.6f}")
    print(f"FAILURES={report['failure_count']}")
    return 0 if not failures else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

    height, width = image_bgr.shape[:2]
    ratio = min(size / height, size / width)
    resized_width = max(1, int(width * ratio))
    resized_height = max(1, int(height * ratio))
    resized = cv2.resize(
